translations.web: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
translations.bsb: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring.
translations.kjv: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
translations.asv: Boast not thyself of tomorrow; For thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
